name: Coastal and Marine Ecosystems of the Bijagós Archipelago – Omatí Minhô
description: Off the coast of Guinea-Bissau, the Bijagós Archipelago is the only active deltaic archipelago on Africa's Atlantic coast. Its mangroves, mudflats and tidal shallows shelter manatees, dolphins and more than 870,000 migratory shorebirds. On Poilão Island, endangered green turtles come ashore to nest, making it one of the region's most important turtle beaches.
